title: Cycle-budget batching -> hf ship (commit/push/PR)
objective: ADR-0001 §4: ledger-derived per-session cycle counter (checkpoints since session_start); surface cycles:n/flush in status; at threshold next_command=hf ship. `hf ship` = add+commit (ref task ids) -> push branch -> gh pr create --base trunk, emit pr_opened. Outward action is permission-gated and retryable, never a hard wall.
acceptance_criteria: Cycle-budget batching -> hf ship (commit/push/PR): implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
